manual.behavior: A validated option tree. Construction bounds every level and rejects unsupported discriminator combinations. Commands support at most group → subcommand → leaf; no unbounded recursion or hidden fetching occurs. Validates one complete option with type-specific fields and bounded children. - Parameters: - type: One of the eleven documented option kinds; unknown outgoing kinds are not accepted. - name: 1...32 scalars satisfying Discord's lowercase Unicode slash-name grammar. - description: Required 1...100 scalar explanation. - nameLocalizations: Omitted/null/dictionary of names following the same naming rules. - descriptionLocalizations: Omitted/null/dictionary of 1...100 scalar descriptions. - required: Optional leaf requirement, default nil; forbidden on subcommands/groups even when false. - choices: Optional 0...25 choices for string/integer/number, compatible with the selected kind. - options: Optional 0...25 children; groups contain only subcommands and subcommands only leaves. - channelTypes: Optional distinct known channel filters, permitted only for channel options. - minValue: Optional exact numeric minimum for integer/number options; must not exceed maxValue. - maxValue: Optional exact numeric maximum; integers are in ±(2^53-1), numbers in ±2^53. - minLength: Optional string minimum in 0...6000, no greater than maxLength. - maxLength: Optional string maximum in 1...6000. - autocomplete: Optional string/integer/number autocomplete; true is incompatible with any choices array. - fileTypes: Optional 0...10 attachment filters: image/video/audio or dot-prefixed extensions, at most 16 scalars each per preview. Case-insensitive duplicates are rejected; content validation remains caller-owned. - Throws: Invalid-value for incompatible fields, duplicate names/filters, ordering/nesting, locale/text/number limits; limitExceeded when the combined localized text exceeds 8000 scalars. Entire construction is synchronous and immutable. API v10 verified and locally added 2026-10-16.
